changelog:
CineVault 4.8 by SNSR

Seek Lock and playback controls
• Seek Lock now fades with video, live-TV and download playback controls and reappears when the controls are revealed
• Lock state stays on while the controls are hidden, so an accidental tap or gesture cannot change the position, brightness or volume
• Seek Lock works online and after download, with the same tap, double-tap, long-press 2x, brightness and volume gestures users relied on before

Liquid-glass UI and navigation
• Midnight Amethyst liquid-glass surfaces remain available across Home, Search, Details, Library, Live TV, OTT Hub and Settings
• The CineVault wordmark and liquid bottom navigation remain stable, with draggable spring motion
• Branded loading and buffering states connect the CineVault mark to Play

Streaming, subtitles and playback
• ExoPlayer (Media3) streaming continues with HLS and DASH, quality selection and subtitle support • Episode-specific subtitles and English preference keep working as before • Embedded audio and subtitle tracks from the stream are preserved
• Brightness, media-volume and horizontal seek gestures with glass overlays remain available

Continue Watching, downloads and offline playback
• Library with Continue Watching, Watchlist, History and recent searches stays intact
• Persistent download queue, resume and playback of downloaded files continue to work as before

MovieBox, AniFam, Live TV and Watch Together • Both MovieBox and AniFam providers remain available, including alternate dub/sub tracks where present
• Live TV favorites, search history and playback continue working
• Watch Together synced rooms continue to work for shared viewing

Chromecast, Picture-in-Picture, search, favorites and user data
• Chromecast, Picture-in-Picture, search history, favorites, saved preferences and local user data keep working without changes
• Update downloads are validated for package, version and signing compatibility before installation, so existing users can update in place

Compatibility
• Android 7.0 and newer remain supported
• Existing providers, playback behavior, subtitles, gestures and stored app data remain unchanged
